ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: The Cauldron
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
POISONFOREST_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 (Phase A row 10 of the biome-mod-architecture split). A low, wet-black forest standing in permanent dusk over ground that breathes a cold, metal-rich gas. Fully generalized: it names no other franchise or campaign and is playable standalone on any generated RimWorld planet. A separate frozen campaign world's own Poison Forest instance is unaffected and unrelated; this is a new sibling biome for everyone else's worlds, not a rename of that one.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it.
Ships the biome and its own placement worker (RM_BiomeWorker_Cauldron, replacing the donor BiomesPlus.BiomeWorker_PoisonForest — a donor type in workerClass is a hard dependency the RimMandrake tier may not assume), two new terrain defs (RM_CauldronSoil / RM_CauldronSoilRich, replacing the donor BiomesPlus terrain names the twin used with no def backing them anywhere in this repo), three renamed-and-duplicated flora ThingDefs (RM_TwistingThornwood, RM_TreeMartyr, RM_DarkCrust — the frozen twin's own RUT_-prefixed copies stay in place unchanged, serving the live campaign world and RUT_CrackedLands, which still shares RM_TwistingThornwood's species; this mod's copies are its own, per the "duplicate, then diverge" rule for content wired into two biome mods), 21 non-Star-Wars fauna rows inline, and a Mod Settings screen with the standard worldgen-rarity master toggle (MOD_OPTIONS_RETROFIT_1 doctrine — defaults = shipped behavior, 0 = never generates).
CAULDRON_RULED_CONTENT_1: the seven Alpha Biomes wildPlants this biome once named (crystal flower, blood bouquet, raven nettle, red bugloss, giant agaritox, keening cordax, giant toxic flower) are now owned RM_ defs, so wildPlants no longer depends on Alpha Biomes; RM_Xithess (a filter-frond with a vent-chemistry yield) joins them. Three owned natives are added (RM_Vexxiss, RM_Zisska, RM_Eskith, with RM_Vexxith shear material and RM_ZisskaMeat) and four Alpha Animals imports (Plasmorph, Lucifer bug, Radyak, Ripper hound), each MayRequire'd. The thornwood and martyr tree carry a growth-scaled metal second yield.
CAULDRON_MECHANICS_BUILD_1: the biome's four own weathers (scatter-dusk, vapour bank, dewfall, vent bloom) replace the donor fog; a vent bloom builds a slow metal-load condition on anyone outdoors under open sky. The vexxiss puts out fires, goes for whoever started them, and turns the water it wades through toxic. Each is a Mod Settings toggle. Not yet built: the vexxiss's wild-shear job.
VEXXITH_CLOSED_LOOP_BUILD_1: anything made of vexxith, and the plate-only acid-proof vexxith door, takes no acid damage (vanilla acid burn, and the Warscar bloom acid when that biome is present). This is the mod's one Harmony patch, so it now needs Harmony. Both are Mod Settings toggles.
⚠️ Not fully donor-free: the world-map texture (Biomes/PoisonForest, BiomesPlus) carries no MayRequire, inherited unchanged from the frozen campaign twin. The inline fauna rows (Genetic Rim, Alpha Animals, Alpha Memes, Horrors) are individually MayRequire'd and degrade gracefully without them.
NOT in this mod: the Star Wars-tier fauna (Neebray, Mynock, GraniteSlug, RSW_Screecher, RSW_VentStalker) that inhabit this biome in the campaign — those ride a Utinni patch onto this mod's own RM_Cauldron def rather than living inside it, per the Q11a naming-tier ruling. The toxic-meat Star Wars cuisine chain and any other campaign plot content stay in Utinni entirely.
